title: Egy nap: A Whole Day, Present Tense

sections.title: One paragraph, not six sentences
sections.content: This lesson pulls together Units 1-2: the daily-routine verbs you learned first (felkelek, zuhanyozom, reggelizem, dolgozom, ebédelek, vacsorázom) with the time words that connect them. -kor gives a clock time (hétkor), and előbb, aztán, utána and végül string the actions into one flowing description instead of a list of short sentences.

sections.title: Connecting a day
rows: at seven, at half past seven

items.spanish: Hétkor felkelek, előbb zuhanyozom, aztán gyorsan reggelizem.
items.english: I get up at seven, first I shower, then I have breakfast quickly.

items.spanish: Kilenctől ötig dolgozom, közben rövid ebédszünetet tartok.
items.english: I work from nine to five, and take a short lunch break in the meantime.

items.spanish: Munka után hazamegyek, és este Károllyal vacsorázom.
items.english: After work I go home, and in the evening I have dinner with Károly.

sections.content: You don't need és before every clause — a comma between előbb, aztán, utána and végül is usually enough, and it reads more naturally than stacking és, és, és.
